description: This file defines the Overview class, which models the overview data of an email fetched via IMAP, including email attributes like subject, from, to, date, message ID, size, and various flags. It appears to be used within the InboundEmail module of a CRM system, likely for managing email metadata.

classes.name: Overview
classes.description: A class that represents an overview object for email metadata fetched from IMAP, with properties capturing various email headers and flags, initialized with metadata definitions from external files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Overview object by loading metadata definitions for email cache fields and indices from external metadata files.
